dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave parabolic curve following the trailing edge from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-rounded vertex with a small pixel radius at the tip of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior slope measured at approximately 55 degrees relative to the dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.4:1 ratio of maximum base width to the vertical height of the fin.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large convex arc radius forming a prominent, rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum visible with a high thickness-to-length ratio relative to the cranial mass.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel junction where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular pale-colored lesion or pigment mark located on the mid-dorsal flank, posterior to the blowhole region.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible eye-to-flipper dark stripe or pigment band extending along the lower lateral cranial surface.
